questions.prompt: Which OSI layer do mail protocols like SMTP and IMAP belong to?
Mail protocols run over UDP, like DHCP and most DNS lookups.
A DHCP server listens on which UDP port? (number)
And a DHCP client listens on which UDP port? (number)
Which DNS record type tells a sender where to deliver mail for a domain?
An MX record may point at a CNAME alias.
Why would a receiving mail server look up a PTR record?
options: To check that the sending server's IP address maps back to a name
